document: Alone Against the Dark Defying the Triumph of the Ice (A Solo Play Call of Cthulhu Mini Campaign) Chaosium Publication 23154 (Matthew Costello, Mike Mason, Petr Štovik etc.) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
You may purchase equipment and weapons here to your usual 
expenditure allowance (using the standard lists in the Call of 
Cthulhu Rulebook, or the Investigator Handbook). Note that the 
cost of anything you buy here is marked up by 200%. If you 
succeed with a Fast Talk or Charm roll at Hard difficulty you 
can barter the prices down to normal.
You can also hire bearers here; maximum of three in your auto. 
Because of the heat, you personally may not carry more than 
three items/weapons. Return to the market at 134.
(134)
